statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-42899 (GHSA-9v76-4qcc-frgh) is an ASP.NET Core denial of service issue: a loop with an unreachable exit condition lets an unauthenticated attacker make the server stop responding over the network. Microsoft lists the ASP.NET Core 10.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.7 and fixed in 10.0.8 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-9v76-4qcc-frgh, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/397, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.8/10.0.8.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold: every build ships the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework at its own .NET version, in aspnetcore10-runtime and in the .NET SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and the ASP.NET Core runtime pack at that version in dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap: 10.0.2 to 10.0.7 in the first six builds and 10.0.8 or later from 10.0.8-r0 on. The range ends at 10.0.8-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.
